title: Extract Bits
text: Output selection of contiguous bits from input signal, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Bits to extract} sets Method for extracting bits Upper; {Number of bits}, {Bit indices} sets the contiguous range of bits to output and {Output scaling mode}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Extracted bits scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Bits to extract
params.values: Method for extracting bits Upper half (default) | Lower half | Range starting with most significant bit | Range ending with least significant big | Range of bits

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of bits to output 8 (default) | scalar positive integer

params.name: Bit indices
params.values: Contiguous range of bits to output [0 7] (default) | two-element vector | scalar positive integer

params.name: Output scaling mode
params.values: Output scaling mode Preserve fixed-point scaling (default) | Treat bit field as an integer
